blocks.en: Bringing ReLEAF from the laboratory to farms requires more than demonstrating that our system works. We must also understand how it can be implemented safely and legally. We examined regulations in Taiwan, the European Union, the United States, and potential Southeast Asian markets, focusing on three components: the bioreactor, engineered bacteria, and cell-free plant protectants. The same biological output may be classified as a fertilizer, plant biostimulant, or pesticide depending on its function, formulation, intended use, and jurisdiction. By investigating requirements for biosafety, product classification, efficacy, and market approval, with Taiwan as our starting point and the Philippines as our first international market to explore, we aim to guide ReLEAF toward responsible real-world implementation.

blocks.en: ReLEAF's regulatory review identifies three separate questions: how the agricultural output is classified, how the engineered production culture is contained, and which requirements apply to the bioreactor. The most important finding is that a potential regulatory pathway is not an approval. A fertilizer or plant-biostimulant route is being investigated for ReLEAF's cell-free output, while the classification of the engineered Bacillus subtilis culture and the final equipment requirements remain separate questions. For post-Jamboree development, BoPep4 will also be investigated as a potential gray-mold-control product in Taiwan. This use may trigger a microbial fertilizer/fungicide pathway distinct from the fertilizer or plant-biostimulant route.

有機農業相容性

blocks.en: ReLEAF's organic-farming compatibility depends not only on whether viable engineered Bacillus subtilis cells enter the agricultural environment, but also on whether each country's organic standards permit agricultural inputs manufactured using genetically engineered organisms. Although ReLEAF's bioreactor is designed to retain the production bacteria behind a 0.2 µm hollow-fiber membrane and deliver cell-free protective proteins and peptides, this containment design does not automatically establish organic eligibility. The following assessment follows ReLEAF's planned market-entry sequence.

blocks.zh: ReLEAF 能否相容於有機農業，不只取決於是否有活的工程化 Bacillus subtilis 細胞進入農業環境，也取決於各國的有機標準是否允許使用以基因改造生物製造的農業資材。雖然 ReLEAF 的生物反應器在設計上會把生產菌留在 0.2 µm 中空纖維膜之後，只輸出無細胞的保護性蛋白質與胜肽，這樣的圍阻設計並不自動成立有機資格。以下評估依循 ReLEAF 規劃的市場進入順序。
1. 臺灣：初步法規評估

blocks.en: Taiwan's Organic Agriculture Promotion Act explicitly defines organic agriculture as production that does not use genetically modified organisms or their products. Article 15 of the Act further emphasizes the restrictions prohibiting substances outside the officially permitted list. Consequently, ReLEAF's use of engineered B. subtilis creates a potential compatibility barrier even if the final formulation contains no viable production cells. Before targeting certified organic farms, ReLEAF should seek clarification from the Ministry of Agriculture and an accredited organic certification body on whether the protective proteins are considered products derived from or produced by a GMO and whether the specific formulation can qualify as an authorized input. Conventional agricultural registration and organic eligibility must be evaluated separately (Agriculture and Food Agency–Ministry of Agriculture, AFA–MOA).

blocks.zh: 臺灣的有機農業促進法明確把有機農業定義為不使用基因改造生物或其產品的生產方式。該法第 15 條進一步強調禁止使用官方許可清單以外物質的限制。因此，即使最終配方不含任何活的生產細胞，ReLEAF 使用工程化的 B. subtilis 仍可能構成相容性障礙。在以取得有機認證的農場為目標之前，ReLEAF 應向農業部與經認證的有機認證機構釐清：這些保護性蛋白質是否被視為源自基因改造生物或由基因改造生物所生產的產品，以及特定配方能否取得許可資材的資格。常規農業登記與有機資格必須分開評估（農業部農糧署，AFA–MOA）。
2. 菲律賓：第一個國際市場評估

blocks.en: The Philippines has an established organic agriculture framework under Republic Act No. 10068, as amended by Republic Act No. 11511, with national standards covering organic crop production and agricultural inputs. ReLEAF should consult the Bureau of Agriculture and Fisheries Standards (BAFS) and a recognized organic certification body to determine whether the cell-free formulation is permitted under the applicable Philippine National Standards. The review should distinguish the intended use of the product for abiotic-stress tolerance from microbial biocontrol applications and examine whether the engineered manufacturing process affects eligibility. Until the relevant provisions and input requirements have been confirmed, ReLEAF should classify organic compatibility in the Philippines as unresolved rather than assume that cell-free delivery qualifies for organic use (Bureau of Agriculture and Fisheries Standards, BAFS).

blocks.zh: 菲律賓依 Republic Act No. 10068（經 Republic Act No. 11511 修正）建立了有機農業框架，並有涵蓋有機作物生產與農業資材的國家標準。ReLEAF 應諮詢 Bureau of Agriculture and Fisheries Standards（BAFS）與受認可的有機認證機構，確認無細胞配方在適用的菲律賓國家標準下是否被允許。這項檢視應區分產品用於非生物逆境耐受的預期用途與微生物生物防治的應用，並檢查工程化的製造過程是否影響資格。在相關條文與資材要求獲得確認之前，ReLEAF 在菲律賓的有機相容性應歸類為未解決，而不是假設無細胞輸送就符合有機使用（Bureau of Agriculture and Fisheries Standards, BAFS）。
3. 泰國：區域擴張評估

blocks.en: Thailand's agricultural organic standard, TAS 9000-2564, covers organic production, processing, labeling and marketing. ReLEAF should assess the relevant crop-production and input requirements with the National Bureau of Agricultural Commodity and Food Standards (NBACFS) and an appropriate certification body. The central question is whether the protective formulation is permitted when its active proteins are produced by engineered bacteria, even if those bacteria are retained in the bioreactor. ReLEAF should also confirm whether the relevant certification scheme applies additional restrictions to GMO-derived agricultural inputs. Organic certification requirements should be distinguished from the separate authorization needed to market the product as a conventional agricultural input (Thai Agricultural Standard, TAS).

blocks.zh: 泰國的農業有機標準 TAS 9000-2564 涵蓋有機生產、加工、標示與行銷。ReLEAF 應與 National Bureau of Agricultural Commodity and Food Standards（NBACFS）及適當的認證機構一起評估相關的作物生產與資材要求。核心問題是：當保護性配方的活性蛋白質是由工程化細菌生產，即使這些細菌被留在生物反應器內，該配方是否仍被允許。ReLEAF 也應確認相關的認證方案是否對源自基因改造生物的農業資材另有限制。有機認證要求應與把產品作為常規農業資材上市所需的另一套授權分開看待（Thai Agricultural Standard, TAS）。
4. 美國：對排除方法的限制

blocks.en: The United States Department of Agriculture's National Organic Program (NOP, USDA) prohibits genetic engineering and other excluded methods in organic production. Its regulations also restrict the use of ingredients produced through excluded methods, while crop-production inputs must satisfy the applicable substance requirements. Consequently, ReLEAF faces a substantial potential barrier to use on USDA-certified organic farms: removing viable engineered bacteria from the final formulation would not, by itself, resolve the question of whether the active proteins were produced using a prohibited method. ReLEAF should obtain an assessment from a USDA-accredited organic certifier before considering an organic-use claim. Conventional product authorization would not establish USDA organic eligibility (United States Department of Agriculture, USDA).

5. 越南與印尼：平行評估

blocks.en: Vietnam and Indonesia should be evaluated as separate regulatory markets, even though ReLEAF plans to investigate them during the same expansion phase.

blocks.zh: 越南與印尼應被視為各自獨立的法規市場，即使 ReLEAF 計畫在同一個擴張階段調查它們。

blocks.en: In Vietnam, ReLEAF should assess the national organic agriculture framework, including Decree No. 109/2018/ND-CP and the applicable technical standards, such as, but not limited to: Decree No. 69/2010/ND-CP, Decree No. 84/2019/ND-CP (amended), Law on Plant Protection and Quarantine (2013), and Law on Product and Goods Quality (or Law No. 05/2007/QH12), with the competent authorities and appropriate certification body. The review should establish whether an agricultural input manufactured using engineered B. subtilis can be used in certified organic crop production when the final formulation is cell-free. The precise treatment of GMO-produced proteins must be confirmed before ReLEAF can classify the product as compatible.

The review should establish whether an agricultural input manufactured using engineered B. subtilis can be used in certified organic crop production when the final formulation is cell-free. blocks.zh: 在越南，ReLEAF 應與主管機關及適當的認證機構一起評估國家有機農業框架，包括 Decree No. 109/2018/ND-CP 與適用的技術標準，例如（但不限於）：Decree No. 69/2010/ND-CP、Decree No. 84/2019/ND-CP（修正）、Law on Plant Protection and Quarantine（2013）與 Law on Product and Goods Quality（即 Law No. 05/2007/QH12）。這項檢視應確立：當最終配方是無細胞的，以工程化 B. subtilis 製造的農業資材能否用於取得有機認證的作物生產。在 ReLEAF 能把產品歸類為相容之前，必須先確認基因改造生物所生產蛋白質的確切處理方式。

blocks.en: In Indonesia, the assessment should follow the applicable National organic standard, including SNI 6729:2025, which revised the previous organic agriculture standard and will determine whether or not organic farmers can use ReLEAF to relieve their crop stress yet sell their harvest with the “ORGANIK Indonesia” label from the accredited Organic Certification Body (Lembaga Sertifikasi Organik). ReLEAF should confirm the relevant agricultural inputs. Particular attention should be given to whether the manufacturing process itself affects eligibility, rather than relying solely on analytical evidence that viable bacteria are absent from the output. Both markets should remain under regulatory assessment until written clarification is obtained (Government of Vietnam).

blocks.en: The European Union presents a significant challenge for ReLEAF's organic-market ambitions. Regulation (EU) 2018/848 explicitly excludes GMOs, products produced from GMOs and products produced by GMOs from organic production, subject to the regulation's stated exceptions. Because ReLEAF's protective proteins are manufactured using engineered B. subtilis, the product may fall within these restrictions even if the final formulation contains no viable cells. A demonstration of membrane integrity or the absence of detectable recombinant DNA would support the product's technical characterization but would not independently establish organic eligibility, which ReLEAF has the evidence detailed in Biomanufacturing page’s Regulations and Biosafety. ReLEAF should obtain a legal and certification assessment of the precise production process before considering the EU organic market. Conventional fertilizer or plant-biostimulant authorization would remain a separate requirement (Parliament and Council).

blocks.en: Malaysia's myOrganic certification guidelines explicitly prohibit GMOs and their products in organic farming. This creates a potential compatibility barrier similar to those identified in Taiwan, the United States and the European Union. The final assessment should consider the engineered production organism, manufacturing process, final formulation and intended agricultural use. ReLEAF should not advertise the product as suitable for certified organic farms until its eligibility has been confirmed (Department of Agriculture, DOA).

blocks.en: The hollow-fiber membrane (0.2 µm) is designed to retain the production culture and let the soluble products through. Under Regulation (EU) 2019/1009, PFC 6(B) is the category for non-microbial plant biostimulants, and PFC 6 covers functions including improving plant tolerance to abiotic stress. However, our review has not identified a general numerical residual-DNA limit in the Regulation that can be stated as a PFC 6(B) requirement. ReLEAF should therefore not claim a legal DNA threshold unless a specific provision, applicable delegated act, harmonized standard, conformity-assessment requirement, or competent authority interpretation is identified. Independently of the legal threshold, ReLEAF will validate its cell-free output by testing for viable production organisms and residual recombinant DNA, report the methods and detection limits, and describe the hollow-fiber membrane as “designed to retain cells” until retention has been experimentally validated. In essence, containment is not only an engineering requirement; it determines the exposure pathway that regulators must consider, and separating the engineered production organism from the cell-free output lets regulators assess the two as distinct questions.

blocks.en: EU Reference Point: Abiotic-Stress Biostimulants vs. Plant-Protection Products
blocks.text: EU Reference Point: Abiotic-Stress Biostimulants vs. Plant-Protection Products
blocks.zh: 歐盟參考點：非生物逆境生物刺激素與植物保護產品的分別

blocks.en: The European Union (EU) provides a useful reference point for evaluating ReLEAF's regulatory strategy because it has an established framework for plant biostimulants and harmonized product-safety requirements. Rather than regulating every agricultural technology under a single category, the EU distinguishes products according to their intended function, composition, and method of use. This is particularly relevant to ReLEAF, which combines an engineered bacterial culture, a controlled bioreactor, and plant-protective outputs.
blocks.text: The European Union (EU) provides a useful reference point for evaluating ReLEAF's regulatory strategy because it has an established framework for plant biostimulants and harmonized product-safety requirements. Rather than regulating every agricultural technology under a single category, the EU distinguishes products according to their intended function, composition, and method of use. This is particularly relevant to ReLEAF, which combines an engineered bacterial culture, a controlled bioreactor, and plant-protective outputs.
blocks.zh: 歐盟（EU）為評估 ReLEAF 的法規策略提供了有用的參考點，因為它對植物生物刺激素已有成熟的框架，也有調和的產品安全要求。歐盟並不是把所有農業技術都放進單一類別來管，而是依產品的預期功能、組成與使用方式加以區分。這一點對 ReLEAF 特別相關，因為 ReLEAF 結合了工程化的細菌菌液、一台受控的生物反應器，以及具植物保護功能的產出物。

blocks.en: Under Regulation (EU) 2019/1009, plant biostimulants fall under Product Function Category (PFC) 6. These products must stimulate plant nutrition processes independently of their nutrient content, with the aim of improving characteristics such as tolerance to abiotic stress, nutrient-use efficiency, or plant quality. The regulation distinguishes microbial plant biostimulants (PFC 6(A)) from non-microbial plant biostimulants (PFC 6(B)). However, its Component Material Category 7 (CMC 7) restricts eligible microorganisms to specified groups, including Azotobacter, mycorrhizal fungi, Rhizobium, and Azospirillum. Therefore, ReLEAF cannot assume that its engineered Bacillus subtilis culture qualifies as an EU microbial plant biostimulant under this framework. A separately collected, cell-free protectant output may warrant assessment under the non-microbial category, but its eligibility and conformity requirements would depend on its composition, function, and applicable legal provisions (Regulation EU 2019/1009 Annexes I & II).

blocks.zh: 在 Regulation (EU) 2019/1009 之下，植物生物刺激素屬於產品功能類別（PFC）6。這類產品必須在不依賴其養分含量的情況下刺激植物的營養過程，目的是改善諸如非生物逆境耐受性、養分利用效率或植物品質等特性。該規章把微生物型植物生物刺激素（PFC 6(A)）與非微生物型植物生物刺激素（PFC 6(B)）分開。不過，其成分材料類別 7（CMC 7）把可用的微生物限制在特定幾群，包括 Azotobacter、菌根真菌、Rhizobium 與 Azospirillum。因此，ReLEAF 不能假設其工程化的 Bacillus subtilis 菌液在這個框架下符合歐盟微生物型植物生物刺激素的資格。另外單獨收集的無細胞保護劑產出物，或許值得依非微生物類別評估，但其資格與符合性要求將取決於組成、功能與適用的法律條文（Regulation EU 2019/1009 Annexes I & II）。

blocks.en: The bioreactor itself presents a separate regulatory consideration. Machinery placed on the EU market must satisfy the applicable safety and conformity requirements, including the relevant CE-marking obligations. Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 replaces the former Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and applies from January 20, 2027. ReLEAF would therefore need to assess the requirements applicable to its intended market-entry date, alongside any other legislation relevant to the device's electrical, electromagnetic, or pressure-related components (Regulation EU 2023/1230).

blocks.en: The European Union, the unified union of 27 member states in the region of Europe, holds 156.4 Mha of agricultural farmland with an average farm size of 17 ha and a clear non-microbial biostimulant category that scores well for the permeate. blocks.en: Kelpak provides a useful case study for understanding why ReLEAF cannot assume that one regulatory classification will apply globally. Kelpak is a seaweed-derived agricultural biostimulant whose regulatory treatment differs across markets, even though the underlying product remains substantially the same. This makes it particularly relevant to ReLEAF, where the same cell-free protectant output may encounter different legal definitions, registration requirements, and evidence standards depending on the destination market.

blocks.en: The table shows the pattern: Kelpak does not change when it crosses a border, but its pathway does. We therefore treat each target market as a separate regulatory assessment. In the European Union, Kelpak is positioned within the EU fertilizing-products framework, demonstrating how a harmonized regional system can provide a defined pathway for plant-biostimulant products. In Taiwan, its registration as a fertilizer illustrates how the same type of agricultural input can instead be evaluated through a national fertilizer classification system. In the United States, Kelpak's market position demonstrates the more decentralized nature of agricultural-input regulation, where federal considerations, organic-input requirements, and individual state requirements can all affect market access.

blocks.en: The contrast is important for ReLEAF because regulatory classification depends not only on the biological material itself, but also on its formulation, intended function, claims, and jurisdiction. Kelpak therefore serves as the main regulatory case study for our project: the product does not change simply because it crosses a border, but the regulatory pathway governing that product can change substantially. ReLEAF consequently treats each target market as a separate regulatory assessment rather than assuming that approval or classification in one jurisdiction automatically transfers to another.

blocks.en: Sagarika is a useful example of a seaweed-derived plant biostimulant, rather than a confirmed microbial biostimulant. IFFCO describes Sagarika Liquid as a concentrated extract of red and brown marine algae (28% w/w), containing naturally occurring plant-growth substances and nutrients. Its official product information therefore supports describing it as a seaweed-extract product; the sources reviewed do not establish that the marketed product is itself a microbial inoculant. Sagarika is relevant to ReLEAF as a comparison for how an agricultural biostimulant is formulated, positioned, and regulated, but it is not a direct biological analog for ReLEAF's engineered production culture or purified/cell-free protein output. India's regulatory framework for biostimulants was amended through Notification S.O. 882(E) of February 23, 2021, which added biostimulants to the Fertilizer Control Order, 1985, including Clause 20C and Schedule VI.

attrs.en: A three-circle Venn diagram for the United States, the European Union and Taiwan. Each circle lists the bioreactor, culture and output rules for that market, such as OSHA equipment requirements and EPA TSCA 40 C.F.R. Part 725 in the United States, Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and Directive 2009/41/EC in the EU, and BSMI and the Fertilizer Management Act in Taiwan. The overlaps list shared concepts such as GMO biosafety and plant-biostimulant or fertilizer regulation. The centre reads: core claim, improves plant tolerance to abiotic stress; agricultural input rather than pesticide.
attrs.zh: 一張美國、歐盟與臺灣的三圓文氏圖。每個圓列出該市場對生物反應器、菌液與產出物的規定，例如美國的 OSHA 設備要求與 EPA TSCA 40 C.F.R. Part 725、歐盟的 Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 與 Directive 2009/41/EC，以及臺灣的 BSMI 與肥料管理法。重疊處列出共通概念，例如基因改造生物的生物安全，以及植物生物刺激素或肥料法規。中央寫著：核心宣稱，改善植物對非生物逆境的耐受性；屬於農業資材而非農藥。

attrs.en: A tree diagram. The Ministry of Agriculture branches to the Agriculture and Food Agency, which covers fertilizers and biostimulants, and to the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency, which covers chemical pesticides (insecticide, bactericide, herbicide, growth regulator), biological pesticides (microbial pesticide, natural materials, biochemical pesticides) and non-registered plant protection materials (high-safety active biological ingredients).
attrs.zh: 一張樹狀圖。農業部分出農糧署，主管肥料與生物刺激素；以及動植物防疫檢疫署，主管化學農藥（殺蟲劑、殺菌劑、除草劑、生長調節劑）、生物農藥（微生物農藥、天然素材、生化農藥）與免登記植物保護資材（高安全性生物活性成分）。

attrs.en: A tree diagram for the EU. The bioreactor leads to device regulation and a question mark over CE marking; the culture leads to engineered B. subtilis and GMO or GMM rules; the output leads to the protectant product, Product Function Category PFC 6(B), and Component Material Category.
attrs.zh: 一張歐盟的樹狀圖。生物反應器通向設備法規，以及 CE 標誌上的一個問號；菌液通向工程化的 B. subtilis 與基因改造生物或基因改造微生物的規定；產出物通向保護劑產品、產品功能類別 PFC 6(B) 與成分材料類別。

attrs.en: A flow diagram for the United States. The bioreactor leads to equipment and product safety; the liquid culture leads to USDA-APHIS 7 CFR 340, import and interstate movement, and APHIS review; the protectants lead to intended use, which splits into abiotic stress claims going to state fertilizer or biostimulant registration and pest or regulator claims going to EPA FIFRA registration. All branches meet at commercialization, which splits into federal requirements (USDA, EPA, FDA) and state requirements varying by state.
attrs.zh: 一張美國的流程圖。生物反應器通向設備與產品安全；液態菌液通向 USDA-APHIS 7 CFR 340、進口與跨州運送，以及 APHIS 的審查；保護劑通向預期用途，再分成走各州肥料或生物刺激素登記的非生物逆境宣稱，以及走 EPA FIFRA 登記的害物或調節劑宣稱。所有分支匯集到商業化，再分成聯邦要求（USDA、EPA、FDA）與各州不同的州層級要求。

attrs.en: A chart with regulatory and commercialization challenge on the horizontal axis and strategic market value for ReLEAF on the vertical axis. The Philippines sits highest on value and lowest on challenge, Taiwan and Thailand below it, Vietnam lowest on value in the middle of the challenge axis, Indonesia mid-height and further right, and the European Union high on value and furthest right. Each market lists regulatory advantages (+) and challenges (minus) for ReLEAF.
attrs.zh: 一張圖，橫軸是法規與商業化的難度，縱軸是對 ReLEAF 的策略性市場價值。菲律賓價值最高、難度最低，臺灣與泰國在其下方，越南價值最低且位於難度軸中段，印尼高度居中且更偏右，歐盟價值高且最偏右。每個市場都列出對 ReLEAF 的法規優勢（+）與挑戰（−）。
